name: Carolyn
source: She was friends with the protagonist during their high school days. Carolyn graduated from two college courses with a degree in biology. She was raised by a single mother and never knew her father. Lyn is a sweet and responsible girl, but she was bullied in high school, so she had to learn to defend herself and show firm character at the right moment.
